  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "SOAK {{ing_01|CHICK-PEAS}}, {{ing_02|LENTILS}} AND {{ing_03|PEAS}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "CRUSH {{ing_04|BARLEY}} AND COOK WITH THE LEGUMES."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "WHEN WELL COOKED ADD {{ing_05|plenty of OIL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "NOW CUT {{ing_06|GREENS}}, {{ing_07|LEEKS}}, {{ing_08|CORIANDER}}, {{ing_09|DILL}}, {{ing_10|FENNEL}}, {{ing_11|BEETS}}, {{ing_12|MALLOWS}}, {{ing_13|CABBAGE STRUNKS (all soft and green and very finely cut)}}, ALL SOFT AND GREEN AND VERY FINELY CUT, AND PUT IN A POT."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "THE CABBAGE COOK [separately; also] CRUSH {{ing_14|FENNEL SEED}}, PLENTY OF IT, {{ing_15|ORIGANY}}, {{ing_16|SILPHIUM}}, AND {{ing_17|LOVAGE}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "WHEN GROUND, ADD {{ing_18|BROTH (to taste)}} TO TASTE."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "POUR THIS OVER THE PORRIDGE, STIR."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "AND USE SOME {{ing_19|FINELY CHOPPED CABBAGE STEMS}} TO SPRINKLE ON TOP."
    }
  ],
